challenges.instruction: Welcome to the toy shop! Count the coins on the shelf.
challenges.hint: Count by ones since pennies are worth 1 cent each.

challenges.instruction: Help the shopkeeper count these shining coins.
Time to count the coins for a new puzzle toy.
Count these coins to buy a toy car.
challenges.hint: Skip count by fives to find the total value.

challenges.instruction: Count the coins for the most expensive board game in the shop.
challenges.hint: Skip count by tens for each dime you see.

challenges.instruction: Almost closing time! Count this final pile of coins.
challenges.hint: Skip count by twenty-fives for the quarters.
